# Microsoft Power Automate documentation

Discover how to create automated workflows between apps and services to synchronize files, get notifications, collect data, and more.

## Sections

### Create and design
- Try/Buy Power Automate
- Get started with cloud flows
- Create flows: Automated flows, Scheduled flows, Desktop flows
- AI copilot capabilities: Copilot in cloud flows, Copilot in Process Mining, Copilot in desktop flows
- Process mining: Understand processes and identify opportunities, Power Automate Process Mining, Task mining
- Use solutions: Distribute flows, Create cloud flow in a solution, ALM
- Integrate: Teams flows, SharePoint workflows, Email/meetings/contacts
- Best practices: Plan a project, Automation Kit, Automation adoption

### Administer and extend
- Power Platform admin center
- Administer environments and resources
- Set up data loss prevention policies
- Enterprise developer, ISV, and partner guide
- Work with cloud flows using code
- Work with desktop flows using code (developer/desktop-flow-public-apis)
- Build and certify custom connectors

### Use
- Flows with Dataverse (Add a row, Delete a row, Upload/download files and images)
- Flows with Teams, SharePoint, Email, Forms, Approvals
- Business process flows (Understand, Create, Custom controls, Best practices for columns)
